description: SvCommand, a Cmd+K fuzzy command palette for Svelte 5 built on the shared focus-trap, scroll-lock and dismissable primitives, with arrow-key navigation, grouped commands, shortcut hints, a global hotkey and onRun. The demo pairs it with SvSparkline inline line, area, bar and win-loss charts, SvAvatarGroup with stacked members and an overflow count, and SvScrollArea with themed scrollbars.

faq.question: How do commands get defined?
faq.answer: commands is an array of CommandItem objects with id, label and optional hint, group, icon, shortcut, keywords and disabled; the palette fuzzy-matches the typed text against label and keywords, groups the results and calls onRun with the chosen command.

faq.question: How is the hotkey wired?
faq.answer: hotkey defaults to mod+k, so Cmd or Ctrl+K toggles the palette while it is mounted; mod+p is the alternative and false disables it, and bind:open lets a button open it too.

faq.question: What does SvAvatarGroup do with many members?
faq.answer: It stacks the first max avatars with overlap and shows a +N badge for the rest, sized with the same size prop as SvAvatar.
